input.sql:
WITH min_sal AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) as min_a11, MAX(A11) as max_a11
    FROM financial.district
),
female_low_sal_accounts AS (
    SELECT account.account_id, client.birth_date
    FROM financial.client
    JOIN financial.disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    JOIN financial.account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN financial.district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE client.gender = 'F'
    AND district.A11 = (SELECT min_a11 FROM min_sal)
)
SELECT 
    fls.account_id,
    (SELECT max_a11 - min_a11 FROM min_sal) as gap
FROM female_low_sal_accounts fls
WHERE fls.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM female_low_sal_accounts)
